main.description: Pre-flight check whether `userId` can spend credits for `action`. Computes `cost` from action + payloadBytes (mcp_invoke) and compares to balance. ADR-2604271400.

action.description: Spend action: post / reply / dm / mcp_invoke / inference

toolNsid.description: Required when action=mcp_invoke. Lexicon NSID being invoked.

payloadBytes.description: Estimated request payload size in bytes (mcp_invoke pre-check).

amount.description: Override computed cost (e.g. inference action where caller pre-computes token cost).
